parameters.name: Input NWB Dir
parameters.description: Directory in which to look for the input NWB
parameters.help_text: This should be the name of the directory that contains the nwb file you want processed.

parameters.name: Expected N Trials
parameters.description: Number of trials the session is expected to have (this is an override setting for older files where erroneous harp trials are recorded)
parameters.help_text: Should be the total number of trials (valid and invalid) that the original .mat file contained.

parameters.name: Input Session Dir
parameters.description: Directory in which to look for basic session files

parameters.name: Input Processed Dir
parameters.description: Directory in which to look for source extracted and motion corrected files
